name: Can a standard towel bar be used as a shower grab bar?

mainEntity.name: Can a standard towel bar be used as a shower grab bar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Towel bars are held in place by small set screws and light drywall anchors designed only to hold a few pounds of fabric. If someone slips and grabs a towel bar, it will easily pull away from the wall, causing serious injury. Grab bars feature heavy-gauge metal construction, secure flange plates, and structural lag screws that tie directly into wall framing or rated solid-mount anchors to support sudden, heavy downward loads.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. Towel bars use light brackets that tear out under body weight. Grab bars use structural hardware engineered to support substantial, sudden weight.
